name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) clause is redundant because the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) together with hard Existence(target_picked_up) already guarantees door_open. Remove the Existence(door_open) clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The soft Absence(key_lost) clause is too strict. It penalises any occurrence of key_lost regardless of the door’s state, whereas the task only prefers to avoid dropping the key while the door is still closed. Remove this clause or modify it to reflect the door‑closed condition.

texts: Eventually the target box is picked up.
The door must be opened before the box is picked up.
The key should not be dropped before the door is opened.
